title: Former NFL Star, Ricky Williams, Has Been Fighting For Medical Marijuana For Over Twenty Years. Meets With Trump Officials At White House.

content_html_sanitized:
The excellent website MarijuanaMoment.net reported last week that former NFL player, Ricky Williams, had met with Trump officials at the White House about rescheduling cannabis.

 

It rang a bell.

 

Almost 21 years ago, MarijuanaNews.com reported, Ricky Williams and Our Paxil Problem. The Media Miss the Point, As Usual.

 

We have certainly come a long way since then. Forty states, three territories and the District of Columbia allow the medical use of cannabis products. But unfortunately, the Federal government still keeps cannabis in Schedule One.

See Bush’s New Freedom Initiative: Treatment For Using Cannabis, From The Wonderful Folks Who Brought Us Vioxx, Baycol, Etc. Author of IOM Report Says, " I can't understand why it isn't rescheduled. "

 

That is what brought Ricky Williams to the White House, but twenty years ago he was treated with derision. His successful life since then shames those who would not listen to him and take his story seriously.

 

However, the fact that he and the overwhelming majority of the American people are still being ignored by the American medical establishment is a national disgrace.

See The Problem With Medical Cannabis Isn’t The Cannabis It’s The “Medical”

 

We should all salute Williams for standing up for our freedom.
